TestAHandoverOfAClaimedRoleRetriesAHolderResolutionThatFailed counts that some session read failed, not that the handover's resolution was the one that failed. Pin it to the handover's read, for example by asserting the retry's debug line or that the holder was handed the copy after one failure.

retry() now carries a context-canceled error out of a claimed role's handover, so a listener shutdown that cancels a sweep handover mid-resolution logs 'listener kept role drain failed' at Error. Do not carry a read error that is only the handover's own context ending.
